messages:
Lina: Heads up — double happy news! Nadia P. got promoted to Staff SWE and adopted a little mutt yesterday 🐶🎉 Thinking a small surprise potluck this Friday (May 10) at 3pm in the kitchen. Who's in?
Mike: omg congrats nadia!!! 🎉 i'll bring burritos 🌯
Cass: I'll bring a cake. Any dietary prefs? gluten-free ok? :cake:
Samira: love!! should we do a dog-name poll? also do we have a card? where to hide it
Jen: I can make a card. Can someone put together a short 'why we love nadia' list? 3-5 bullets works.
Lina: Yes — let's do a quick poll for pup names in case they ask. Options: Miso, Pickle, Nimbus. React with 🥟 for Miso, 🥒 for Pickle, ☁️ for Nimbus. Also pls sign up here: http://short.link/potluck-signup (just copy/paste into calendar invite)
OpsBot: Reminder: kitchen reserved Fri 3–4pm. :white_check_mark:
Cass: gluten-free cake is fine.
Mike: also can someone hide a tiny 'congrats' banner? i can bring tape & scissors.
Samira: card location: desk by 7th floor plants. i'll bring marker.
Lina: @Nadia P. — absolutely no spoilers if you see this thread :shushing_face:
Nadia P.: 😭😭 you sneaky people! I already said yes to the promotion but the pup is still a secret from half my family — you guys are too sweet. I promise I didn't read earlier threads. thank you!! ❤️
Jen: ahh partial spoil! ok plan B: we pivot to 'low-key surprise' haha. still bring burritos & cake
Lina: either way, big love. Also any good card messages: 'To Nadia — for all the shipped features and puppy cuddles'?
Mike: perfect. I'll add a GIF to the calendar invite. :dog:
Samira: poll results so far: 🥟 4, 🥒 1, ☁️ 2 (i'll post final after lunch)
OpsBot: Event created: 'Nadia Surprise Potluck' Fri 3pm. Invite sent to team except Nadia P. :lock:
Jen: I'll collect contributions and leave an instructions sticky on 7th floor desk.
Lina: :tada: Thanks everyone — meeting point 2:50pm by elevator C.
